vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain numbered item descriptions, storage locations and received times.
requirements.zh: 维护编号物品描述、存放位置及接收时间。

requirements.en: Protect claimant contact information and distinguish reported claims from verified records.
requirements.zh: 保护认领人联系信息，并区分报告的认领陈述与已核实记录。

requirements.en: Record supervisor-approved releases and reconcile storage exceptions.
requirements.zh: 记录主管批准的交还，并核对存放异常。

requirements.en: Prepare timely retention-review lists without making disposal decisions.
requirements.zh: 及时准备保管复核清单，不作出处置决定。

requirements.en: Preferred: operating experience with a dedicated lost-property database.
requirements.zh: 优先：专用失物数据库操作经验。
